outcome_statement: A real, pure, deterministic scoreOpportunity function plus a self-bootstrapping marketplace_opportunities table and a submit/list route -- the discovery/scoring substrate for the zero-capital autonomous opportunity engine, with zero capital risk and zero AI/model cost.
pain: No real, callable way to score a candidate product/niche opportunity exists -- the concept is strategy-doc prose, not code, so nothing can gate future experiments on evidence yet.
value: The first real, safe stage of an engine that identifies opportunities nonstop and eventually funds marketing/API costs/bills -- buildable and testable today with zero capital and zero external dependency.
success_metrics: scoreOpportunity is deterministic (same inputs -> same output every time)
A strong-signal candidate scores >70; a weak-signal candidate scores <30
Partial-data candidates report confidence:'partial' and name the missing factors, never silently treated as fully evidenced
recordOpportunity persists a real row queryable via listOpportunities
failure_metrics: A partial-data score presented without a confidence flag
Any AI/model call in the scoring path (must stay deterministic per Tier-1 discipline)
constraints: BuilderOS system path only -- no agent hand-build
No live marketplace browsing, no listing creation, no capital spend -- explicitly out of scope this mission
unacceptable_result: A non-deterministic scorer; a score that hides which factors were actually evidenced; any code path that spends money or creates a real marketplace listing
ownership: ARC emits machine twin; Builder executes; Adam owns founder usability verdict
priority_fit: BP_PRIORITY rank 26 -- first real stage of the zero-capital economic engine

point_model.A: Vision -- Adam provides FP in development stage
point_model.B: Chair locks handoff -- corridor protected; Adam done until Alpha
